description.value: The study investigated the role of hippocampal structure and function in valuing imagined outcomes during intertemporal choice, combining fMRI, VBM, and patient comparisons.

spans.text: The aim of the present study was to uncover the role of the hippocampus in the conflict defined by Aristotle between temptations that strike our senses and fictions that we have to generate.

description.value: Participants chose between immediate and delayed food, culture, or sport options, with observed and simulated presentation modes.

Obs/Sim trials contrasting an immediate option presented with a picture and therefore directly observable against a delayed option presented textually and requiring mental simulation; participants chose which option they preferred.

Control trials in which presentation mode was held constant: either both immediate and delayed options were observed (Obs/Obs) or both were simulated from text (Sim/Sim); participants chose which option they preferred.
